notes: <sandbox>/work in argv stands for a fresh scratch copy of this run's inputs/ folder, mounted at /w; the inputs are kept under inputs/ as they ran.
Each log is the container's stdout followed by its stderr. verdict_lines are the lines of the log the recorder keeps (content/audit/tools/record-exemplars.mjs), copied in log order.

run.sh (the S5 recorder's, content/audit/tools/s5s6-inputs.mjs) runs TLC 1.8.0 with one worker once per line of jobs.txt (tag|dir|module|cfg|flags) and prefixes every output line with "[tag] "; the modules and configurations are written by content/audit/tools/exemplar-tlc.mjs, a scenario's module being the case's module with one edit.

TLC's default flags. a5 and a7 are the atomic models the splits replace (Holds with PlaceHold, Charges with ChargeOnce), what the agent checked before splitting. Holds runs with Bal = 100 and Amt 80 or 40, Charges with one, two or three workers.
